title: Beal Level 26 Foundations v24.3.1: Conditional B Lower Bound from Matveev Ratio
description: Branch v24-conditional-b-lower from v24.3.0 6a0a0b1 / 10.5281/zenodo.22731759. Extends BealMatveevThm14.lean and RibetMazur.lean by deriving an explicit conditional lower bound on B from the Matveev ratio bound: matveev_gap3_A_pow_eq_B3_pow_sub_B_pow (A^4 = (B+3)^13 - B^4), matveev_gap3_ratio_explicit (B^4 / A^4 = B^4 / ((B+3)^13 - B^4)), matveev_gap3_conditional_B_lower (IF |Lambda| > exp(C_exp_bound) THEN B^4 / ((B+3)^13 - B^4) > exp(C_exp_bound) and B^4 * (1 + exp(C_exp_bound)) > exp(C_exp_bound) * (B+3)^13), matveev_gap3_conditional_B_lower_of_target, and matveev_gap3_conditional_B_pos_lower. Keeps all v24.0.0 through v24.3.0 lemmas. Target, baker_bound_gap3, and bugeaud_LLL_reduction_conditional stay uninhabited def Prop (Mathlib 4.12 has no Matveev 2000 Thm 1.4).
